prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web landing-page composition, 1440×900 landscape
Primary request: Render an actual edge-to-edge browser content surface for “Quản Lý Dạy Thêm”, not a photograph or physical mockup. A visitor must understand one connected teaching day and complete sign-in immediately.
Real content: “Quản Lý Dạy Thêm”; headline “Ngày dạy chạy đúng nhịp”; “07:30 Đăng nhập”, “09:15 Mở lớp”, “13:30 Xếp lịch”, “15:30 Điểm danh”, “17:00 Chốt phiên”; form “Tên đăng nhập”, “Mật khẩu”, “Đăng nhập”, “Quên mật khẩu?”; attendance “22 / 24”.
Composition concept: timeline-led. One flat digital accordion strip is the page’s layout system and fills the viewport in a bold zig-zag path. It is inspired by a planner’s folded rhythm but exists as responsive web UI, with no desk or photographed paper. The 07:30 fold contains the real sign-in form; later folds demonstrate class, room, teacher, attendance and closing status. The green route line leads the eye through every fold and continues into the first strip of the next section. Compact product mark, “Tổng quan · Vận hành · Bảo mật”, date, and system status sit on one quiet top rail.
Visual law: cool white ruled surfaces, deep navy ink, jade verified states, apricot upcoming, vermilion exceptions. Sturdy Vietnamese-friendly grotesk, small human annotation strokes, crisp time tabs, generous quiet space.
Constraints: unmistakably a functional web page, readable Vietnamese, one dominant accordion system, no desk, no stationery photo, no books, no plants, no device or browser frame, no split hero, no generic card grid, no full dashboard, no glassmorphism, no watermark.
